summary.one_liner: InVesalius is desktop software that builds 3D medical imaging reconstructions from sequences of 2D DICOM scans (CT or MRI).
summary.what_it_does: InVesalius reads 2D medical image sequences such as DICOM files from CT or MRI equipment, plus Analyze, BMP, PNG, JPEG and TIF files. It supports 2D slice viewing with zoom, pan, rotation and brightness/contrast adjustments. Users can segment tissues using 2D slice-based methods, pre-defined threshold ranges, and watershed segmentation, and can edit masks with paint-brush-style tools. It creates 3D surfaces that can be measured, checked for connectivity, and exported as STL, PLY, OBJ, VRML or Inventor files. It also offers volume rendering with presets and a crop plane, plus linear and angular measurement and volume reorientation tools.
use_cases: reconstruct 3D models from CT or MRI scans
measure distances and angles on scans
export 3D surfaces for printing or CAD
view and edit DICOM slice sequences
